live.nameHi: इस्कॉन वृंदावन — लाइव मंगला आरती, दर्शन आरती व गुरु पूजा
live.nameEn: ISKCON Vrindavan — live Mangal Arati, Darshan Arati & Guru Puja
live.whatStreamsEn: Daily long streams titled 'ALL program's || Mangal Āratī & Live Darshan Āratī & Guru Puja || <date>', plus daily Srimad Bhagavatam classes and Kartik Damodarashtakam.

live.nameHi: मायापुर टीवी — श्री धाम मायापुर से लाइव आरती
live.nameEn: Mayapur TV — live aratis from Sri Dham Mayapur (ISKCON HQ)
live.whatStreamsEn: Daily Mangal Arati, Darshan Arati, Bhoga Arati and Sandhya Arati from Sri Dham Mayapur, plus Damodarashtakam in Kartik (its About also lists Kirtan Mela, classes and festivals).

live.nameHi: ठाकुरजी श्री बाँकेबिहारी जी मंदिर, वृंदावन — लाइव दर्शन
live.nameEn: Thakurji Shri Banke Bihari Ji Mandir, Vrindavan — live darshan
live.whatStreamsEn: Several live darshan streams a day titled 'LIVE - ठाकुरजी श्री बॉंकेबिहारी जी मंदिर <date> - वृंदावन' (one description: 'LIVE EVENING DARSHAN FROM VRINDAVAN'). A Vrindavan Today report says the three main aartis (Shringar, Rajbhog, Shayan) are covered.

live.nameHi: गुरु कृपा केवलम् — श्री हित प्रेमानंद जी महाराज का लाइव प्रवचन
live.nameEn: Guru Kripa Kevalam — live pravachan stream of Shri Hit Premanand Ji Maharaj
live.whatStreamsEn: Daily, often twice-daily, long streams titled 'पूज्य महाराज जी का प्रेरणादायक प्रवचन <date>' (satsang, kirtan and pad gayan of Premanand Ji).

live.nameHi: जगद्गुरु श्री कृपालु जी महाराज — दैनिक लाइव प्रवचन श्रृंखला
live.nameEn: Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj Official — daily live-streamed pravachan series
live.channel: Jagadguru Shri Kripalu Ji Maharaj - Official
live.whatStreamsEn: Recorded pravachan series of Kripalu Ji streamed as live premieres, for example Raas Panchaadhyaayi 1-9 and Ved Shaastra Saar 1-7. Older streams were titled 'DAILY Morning LIVE @7:30 AM'. These are not live temple darshan.

live.nameHi: जगद्गुरु कृपालु परिषत् — प्रेम मंदिर वृंदावन से उत्सव लाइव
live.nameEn: Jagadguru Kripalu Parishat (JKP) — festival live broadcasts incl. Prem Mandir Vrindavan
live.whatStreamsEn: Festival and special-day live broadcasts, for example 'Janmashtami Celebrations 2026 | Prem Mandir Vrindavan', Radhashtami 2026, Guru Purnima 2026 and the 104th Jagadguruttam Jayanti 2026. Not daily.

live.nameHi: भक्तिपथ — श्री इंद्रेश उपाध्याय जी की लाइव कथा
live.nameEn: BhaktiPath — live katha of Shri Indresh Upadhyay Ji
live.whatStreamsEn: Live Shrimad Bhagwat Katha and 'Shri Radha Kripa Kataksh' katha from wherever he is speaking (Hapur, Indore and Vrindavan in 2026), whenever a katha is running.

live.nameHi: श्री पुंडरीक गोस्वामी जी — लाइव कथा
live.nameEn: Sri Pundrik Goswami Ji — live katha
live.whatStreamsEn: Live katha: Kartik 'Shri Damodar Katha / Damodar Ashtakam' (Nov 2026), Shrimad Bhagwat Katha and Bhakt Maal Katha.

live.nameHi: श्री देवकीनंदन ठाकुर जी — लाइव कथा
live.nameEn: Shri Devkinandan Thakur Ji — live katha
live.whatStreamsEn: Live Shrimad Bhagwat Katha and Shri Ram Katha streams wherever he is speaking (Himachal, Bengaluru), plus festival events.
